name: Jeera aloo (potatoes tempered with cumin)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 3. The recipe boils the potatoes first, so the 400 g of potatoes is taken as boiled peeled potato (raw and boiled weights assumed equal). Weights: 2 tbsp oil = 27 g, 1 tbsp chopped ginger = 6 g, 1 green chilli = 5 g, salt 3/8 tsp = 2.25 g (midpoint), 1.25 tsp cumin seeds = 2.6 g, 3/4 tsp cumin powder = 1.5 g (as cumin seed), 1.25 tsp coriander powder = 2.3 g (as coriander seed), 3/4 tsp red chilli powder = 2 g, 2.5 tbsp coriander leaves = 2.5 g. Asafoetida, amchur and optional kasuri methi left out (trace amounts). 3 tbsp water = 45 g; assumed the water plus ~3% of potato weight cooks off. A katori or bowl is taken as 1 cup, as everywhere in the catalog.

ingredients.food: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt
